name: Originless
description: One all-in-one storage backend you can drop into anything: your own apps, screenshot tools, pastebin-style pastes, Nostr clients, Reddit posts, forum embeds-anything that needs durable, anonymous file hosting. Built on IPFS with 95% bandwidth reduction compared to previous versions.
short_desc: Private, decentralized file sharing for Nostr and the web
author: besoeasy
